title: Dockerfile syntax corruption and duplicate layers
evidence: Dockerfile contains 7 conflicting FROM lines for Stage 1, 7 conflicting FROM lines for Stage 2, and 4 stacked RUN pip install statements without proper chaining or escaping (lines 2-8, 23-29, 49-57).
user_release_impact: Directly prevents building the production Docker container (docker build fails with syntax errors).
recommended_action: Clean up Dockerfile to a standard 2-stage build (one FROM python:3.10-slim AS builder, one FROM python:3.10-slim AS runtime, single pip install command).

title: Strict mypy return type violation in rl_env.py
evidence: Running `mypy src/nroute --strict` yields: `src\nroute\ml\rl_env.py:434: error: Returning Any from function declared to return 'ndarray[Any, Any]' [no-any-return]`.
user_release_impact: Will fail CI lint-and-type-check pipeline if run in strict mode as configured in CI workflow.

title: Packaging metadata version mismatch (0.1.0 vs v1.3.0)
evidence: `pyproject.toml` defines `version = '0.1.0'` and `src/nroute/__init__.py` defines `__version__ = '0.1.0'`, whereas Git release tags have progressed to `v1.3.0-preflight-validation-engine`.
user_release_impact: PyPI packaging, wheel distribution, and `nroute --version` emit 0.1.0, conflicting with documented milestone versioning.
recommended_action: Synchronize package version in `pyproject.toml` and `src/nroute/__init__.py` to match the target release milestone (e.g., 1.3.0 or 1.4.0).

title: README, CLI Help, and Quickstart promote outdated AI-routing paradigm
evidence: `README.md` and root `nroute --help` describe the product as 'AI-Based Smart Network Routing System' that replaces BGP/OSPF with XGBoost/LSTM/PPO models. The flagship 'Pre-Flight Change-Impact Validation Engine' (`nroute twin validate`) is completely absent from `README.md`, `docs/quickstart.md`, and `docs/cli_reference.md`.
user_release_impact: Prospective users and enterprise adopters receive contradictory messaging; flagship Digital Twin capabilities remain undiscoverable while obsolete ML research models are presented as primary workflows.
recommended_action: Revise `README.md`, `docs/quickstart.md`, and `src/nroute/cli/main.py` docstrings to align with 'High-Performance Network Digital Twin & Pre-Flight Validation Platform'. Prominently document `nroute twin validate`.

title: Non-existent method `plot_throughput()` in README library quickstart
evidence: In `README.md` lines 96-97, the library usage example states: `results = sim.run(); results.plot_throughput()`. `MetricsCollectionResult` has no `plot_throughput` method.
user_release_impact: Users copy-pasting the README quickstart snippet will encounter an immediate AttributeError.
recommended_action: Update README code example to use actual methods on `MetricsCollectionResult` or export via `CSVExporter`/`JSONExporter`.

title: Top-level `nroute` package fails to export Digital Twin and Validation classes
evidence: `src/nroute/__init__.py` exports legacy ML classes (`AIRouter`, `RLRouter`, `GraphTensorBundle`) but does NOT export `DigitalTwinEngine`, `PreFlightValidator`, `PolicyGateConfig`, `ValidationResult`, or `ValidationVerdict`.
user_release_impact: Developers using `nroute` as a library cannot do `from nroute import DigitalTwinEngine, PreFlightValidator`.

title: Default random fallback token in API server locks out local CLI users
evidence: When `NROUTE_API_TOKEN` is unset, `src/nroute/api/server.py` generates `_FALLBACK_TOKEN = secrets.token_hex(32)`, but `nroute api start` neither prints this token nor saves it to a user directory.
user_release_impact: Users running `nroute api start` out-of-the-box receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized for all protected endpoints (`/api/twin/validate`, `/api/health`, `/api/topology`).
recommended_action: In `api_cmd.py` or server startup, log an explicit warning displaying the generated session token when running in local development mode without a preconfigured token.

title: Invalid CLI command syntax in docker-compose.yml
evidence: `docker-compose.yml` line 16 defines `command: ['train', '--model', 'congestion', ...]`. `nroute train` does not accept a `--model` option; its syntax is `nroute train congestion`.
user_release_impact: `docker-compose up` will crash the `nroute-train` container with Click usage error (code 2).

title: `docs/api_reference.md` completely omits Digital Twin & Validation engine
evidence: `docs/api_reference.md` documents `nroute.core`, `nroute.routing`, `nroute.simulation.engine`, `nroute.ml`, and `nroute.visualization.exporters`, but has zero sections for `nroute.simulation.digital_twin`, `nroute.simulation.validator`, `nroute.simulation.policy`, or `nroute.core.openconfig`.
user_release_impact: Developers integrating with NRoute's core value proposition find no official API documentation.
recommended_action: Add dedicated sections for `DigitalTwinEngine`, `PreFlightValidator`, `PolicyGateConfig`, and `ConfigChange` to `docs/api_reference.md`.

title: Aspirational TRD claims vs measured empirical baselines
evidence: TRD section 7 contains aspirational targets (e.g., NetFlow >= 10k rec/s, memory <= 2GB). In reality, measured pytest benchmarks exceed algorithmic targets (Dijkstra 500-node: 0.69ms vs 10ms target; simulation 1000-node: 513 ticks/s vs 100 ticks/s target; pre-flight validation: 1.4ms to 12ms), but NetFlow ingestion benchmarks at 10k scale have high variance.
user_release_impact: No immediate release blocker, but marketing claims should cite verified benchmark results from `artifacts/` rather than TRD design goals.
recommended_action: Publish an official Release Performance Factsheet citing the 120-run benchmark and Direction-C oracle data.
